brand.tone: corporate office satire with brutalist memo clarity and arcade neon escalation
brand.audience_boundary: stylized game UI for a low-poly office roguelite; no photorealism or real-brand imitation
brand.identity_statement: Sterile business forms glow like a scoreboard while desk-object bureaucracy becomes readable combat language.

references.scope: palette, motifs, shape language, typography behavior, formats, and acceptance checks
current HUD layout, runtime scale, and live-text boundaries only
office satire, gameplay nouns, classes, floors, and tone

medium_materials: paper forms, punch cards, stamps, thin ink lines
hierarchy: gold is money and primary action
live engine text stays separate from art
texture_restraint: optional low-opacity scanline or paper grain
texture must not reduce target-size readability
state changes use crisp edges and color before glow

prohibited: real-company logos, copied trade dress, or close brand parodies

logo.purpose: J.O.B. wordmark and badge stamp for menus and store surfaces
logo.output_contract: SVG master plus transparent 2048px-wide PNG variants; badge at 1024px

ui_plate.purpose: stretch-safe panels, buttons, and prompts for HUD and menus
ui_plate.output_contract: SVG master plus transparent 9-slice PNG derivatives

bar.purpose: HP, XP, boss, and event bar frame/fill kit
bar.output_contract: horizontal SVG masters plus 9-slice-able PNG derivatives

crosshair.output_contract: 64px transparent SVG and PNG, 4 styles x 3 states

directional_indicator.output_contract: 256px transparent SVG and PNG radial arc sprite
allowed_variation: opacity and rotation driven by runtime

production_rules.text_strategy: live HTML/engine text except the editable logo SVG
production_rules.logo_strategy: editable SVG master with deterministic raster derivatives
production_rules.font_strategy: Archivo Black or equivalent OFL display face; IBM Plex Mono or equivalent OFL ledger face; platform fallbacks documented in docs/art/FONTS.md
production_rules.transparency: RGBA PNG with transparent corners; no chroma-key source is needed for deterministic vector-derived UI assets
production_rules.provenance_record: docs/art/ASSET_LEDGER.md with generator version, dimensions, hashes, and review state

change_control.update_trigger: palette, corner motif, typography strategy, or asset-family contract changes
change_control.versioning: amend the art bible and lock together; regenerate affected masters and derivatives

open_decisions: confirm production font files and local shipping policy
approve the first HUD screenshot pass at 1080p and Steam #1B2838
